- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER records £3,543.60 TW, up 17.3% WoW from £3,020.07, but down 45.9% YoY from £6,552.99, the steepest YoY fall in the table.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT VINTAGE CHRISTMAS delivers £3,034.33 TW, down 32.7% WoW from £4,510.32, yet up 21.3% YoY from £2,500.80, with orders at 71 TW versus 75 LW.
- ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR shows £2,894.37 TW, up 10.6% WoW and up 42.7% YoY, with units rising from 735 LW to 1,170 TW while orders fell from 42 LW to 37 TW.
- The six products total £25,218.52 TW versus £32,627.63 LW, a 22.7% WoW decline, with the top three lines accounting for £15,746.22 of TW revenue.
- Four of the six products declined WoW, while CHILLI LIGHTS, REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER and ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR gained, adding £3,453.75 combined above their LW levels.
